subject: [video] WP05 update: 708/708 after switching to WP02's vtable accessors
body: Small update to my READY: the supported-property test now drives n2fake_session_vtable()/n2fake_session_encoder() instead of a host-only hook in n2avc_vt.c (the hook is removed). Current command: bash gpu/video/vt/test_avc_vt/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST WP05 PASS 708/708 (354 ASan+UBSan, 354 TSan). STATUS.json numbers updated. Real-encoder branch still waiting for avc/.
